title: Bubble Weapon VFX
description: Bubble Weapon VFX. Milestone 2 credit burn, v1.0. Projectile is an 8×64 strip. Charge, static AOE, and hit are 1-frame images (AOE pose 96×96). `vfx-bubble-aoe-explode` is the 8×96 ground burst, once, origin (0.5, 0.75). Does not replace live hero weapon sheets (fx-sling-pellet, frost, flame, bubble, lightning). Water was not part of this export. SFX keys are notes only; no audio files. vfx-bubble-charge is the selected review winner (object 2bd29209-15f9-42ba-a537-94f5ae3a9309).
